content: Aspirin is used for the temporary relief of **heartburn, acid indigestion, and sour stomach** when accompanied by headache or body aches and pains, as well as **upset stomach with headache from overindulgence in food or drink**, and **pain alone** (e.g., headaches or body aches and pains) [doc name, page 1]. It is also an NSAID (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug) for its pain-relieving and anti-inflammatory effects [doc name, page 1].
